newsitem.title: USA: S.D. 420 MW Big Stone coal-fired seen back Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: S.D. 420 MW Big Stone coal-fired seen back Tuesday.

text.p: The 420 megawatt coal-fired Big Stone power plant was expected to resume operation Tuesday after returning on line briefly over the weekend, an onsite official said Monday.
The generating station, in Big Stone City, S.D., which was idled last Thursday to investigate a problem with a newly installed fire system, returned to service Saturday.
The facility was then shut again after engineers found a boiler tube leak Sunday, the spokesman said.
"It usually takes about 24 hours to fix it," he said.
Engineers still have not uncovered the cause of the shutdown of the plant's fire system, he said.
The Big Stone station is operated and majority owned by Otter Tail Power Co. Northwestern Public Service and Montana-Dakota Utilities are other owners of facility.
